name: valve_ep2_crank_lift
note: EP2's mine lift (ep2_outland_04): a cage lift on a track up a timber-lined shaft from a cave, driven by a winch machine beside it that lacks its centre cog; carry the cog into the machine, pull its lever, and the call buttons light green and send the cage between the two stops

trigger.name: relay_lift_ready
trigger.what: mends the lift: the cog goes in, the lever is pulled

trigger.name: elevator_at_bottom_branch
trigger.what: sends the cage to the other stop, lock or not

extras.what: Not placed by place(): Valve's barnacle hanging in the shaft over the machine, which snatches the cog as it is carried in (the cog's OnMotionEnabled makes it drop its tongue); its OnGrab and OnDeath open the cog's slot, which the piece's starter opens anyway.
